note: a herbaceous plant is not frutescent (a shrub, woody throughout)
a herbaceous plant is not arborescent (a tree)
a herbaceous plant is not ligneous (woody)
a suffrutescent plant (subshrub, woody only at the base) is not arborescent
a frutescent plant (several stems from the base) is not arborescent (one main trunk)
an annual plant is not perennial
an annual plant is not biennial
a biennial plant is not perennial
an evergreen plant is not deciduous
